name: vid2context
description: Turn any video into context for AI agents: transcripts, metadata, chapters, timestamps.

settings.name: Groq API key
settings.description: Optional, leave empty to skip. Groq free tier: fast Whisper speech-to-text and LLMs

settings.name: Gemini API key
settings.description: Optional, leave empty to skip. Google AI Studio free tier LLMs

settings.name: OpenAI API key
settings.description: Optional, leave empty to skip. OpenAI, used last and only when set

settings.name: Ollama URL
settings.description: Optional, leave empty to skip. Local Ollama server, for example http://localhost:11434/v1

settings.name: Local speech-to-text URL
settings.description: Optional, leave empty to skip. Local OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server, for example http://localhost:8000/v1
